orig.zht: 臧霸字宣高，[[泰山華|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.32124106&lng=118.18296699&name=Hua]]人也。父戒，為縣獄掾，據法不聽[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]欲所私殺。[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]大怒，令收戒詣府，時送者百餘人。霸年十八，將客數十人徑於[[費|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.35221866&lng=117.93768412&name=Fei]]西山中要奪之，送者莫敢動，因與父俱亡命[[東海|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=50]]，由是以勇壯聞。
orig.zhs: 臧霸字宣高，[[泰山华|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.32124106&lng=118.18296699&name=Hua]]人也。父戒，为县狱掾，据法不听[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]欲所私杀。[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]大怒，令收戒诣府，时送者百余人。霸年十八，将客数十人径于[[费|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.35221866&lng=117.93768412&name=Fei]]西山中要夺之，送者莫敢动，因与父俱亡命[[东海|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=50]]，由是以勇壮闻。

passages.en: Zang Ba, courtesy name Xuangao, was from [[Hua, Taishan|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.32124106&lng=118.18296699&name=Hua]]. His father, Zang Jie, served as a county prison administrator. Adhering to the law, he refused the [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]'s order to execute a man out of personal spite. The [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]], greatly enraged, ordered Zang Jie seized and brought to his headquarters, dispatching over a hundred men to escort him. Zang Ba, then eighteen, led several dozen retainers to intercept them directly in the hills west of [[Fei|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.35221866&lng=117.93768412&name=Fei]] and rescue his father. None of the escorts dared resist. He then fled into hiding at [[Donghai|/maps/map-overall?admin=50]] together with his father, and from this became known for his bravery and spirit.

orig.zht: 黃巾起，霸從陶謙擊破之，拜[[騎都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。遂收兵於[[徐州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]，與孫觀、吳敦、尹禮等並聚衆，霸為帥，屯於[[開陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]]。太祖之討呂布也，霸等將兵助布。旣禽布，霸自匿。太祖募索得霸，見而恱之，使霸招吳敦、尹禮、孫觀、觀兄康等，皆詣太祖。太祖以霸為[[琅邪|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=51]][[相|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#states-064]]，敦[[利城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84932865&lng=118.79955895&name=Licheng]]、禮[[東莞|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=52]]、觀[[北海|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=44]]、康[[城陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=45]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，割[[青|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]二州，委之於霸。
orig.zhs: 黄巾起，霸从陶谦击破之，拜[[骑都尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。遂收兵于[[徐州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]，与孙观、吴敦、尹礼等并聚众，霸为帅，屯于[[开阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]]。太祖之讨吕布也，霸等将兵助布。既禽布，霸自匿。太祖募索得霸，见而恱之，使霸招吴敦、尹礼、孙观、观兄康等，皆诣太祖。太祖以霸为[[琅邪|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=51]][[相|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#states-064]]，敦[[利城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84932865&lng=118.79955895&name=Licheng]]、礼[[东莞|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=52]]、观[[北海|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=44]]、康[[城阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=45]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，割[[青|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]二州，委之于霸。

passages.en: When the Yellow Turbans rose, Zang Ba followed Tao Qian in defeating them, and was appointed [[Commandant of Cavalry|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]. Zang Ba then raised troops in [[Xu Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]], and together with Sun Guan, Wu Dun, Yin Li, and others, assembled a following under his leadership. They garrisoned at [[Kaiyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]]. When Cao Cao (posthumously honoured as Taizu, the Grand Progenitor) campaigned against Lü Bu, Zang Ba and the others led troops to assist Lü Bu. When Lü Bu was captured, Zang Ba went into hiding. Cao Cao searched for Zang Ba and was delighted when he was eventually found. Cao Cao had Zang Ba persuade Wu Dun, Yin Li, Sun Guan, and Sun Guan's elder brother, Sun Kang, to surrender, and all came to Cao Cao. Cao Cao made Zang Ba [[Chancellor|/translations/officials/regional#states-064]] of [[Langya|/maps/map-overall?admin=51]], and appointed Wu Dun to [[Licheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84932865&lng=118.79955895&name=Licheng]], Yin Li to [[Dongguan|/maps/map-overall?admin=52]], Sun Guan to [[Beihai|/maps/map-overall?admin=44]], and Sun Kang to [[Chengyang|/maps/map-overall?admin=45]] as [[Grand Administrators|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]], entrusting to Zang ba the two provinces of [[Qing|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] and [[Xu|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]].

orig.zht: 太祖之在[[兖州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]，以徐翕、毛暉為將。[[兖州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]亂，翕、暉皆叛。後[[兖州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]定，翕、暉亡命投霸。太祖語劉備，令語霸送二人首。霸謂備曰：「霸所以能自立者，以不謂此也。霸受公生全之恩，不敢違命。然王霸之君可以義告，願將軍為之辭。」備以霸言白太祖，太祖歎息，謂霸曰：「此古人之事而君能行之，孤之願也。」乃皆以翕、暉為[[郡守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。
orig.zhs: 太祖之在[[兖州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]，以徐翕、毛晖为将。[[兖州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]乱，翕、晖皆叛。后[[兖州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]定，翕、晖亡命投霸。太祖语刘备，令语霸送二人首。霸谓备曰：「霸所以能自立者，以不谓此也。霸受公生全之恩，不敢违命。然王霸之君可以义告，愿将军为之辞。」备以霸言白太祖，太祖叹息，谓霸曰：「此古人之事而君能行之，孤之愿也。」乃皆以翕、晖为[[郡守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。

passages.en: When Cao Cao was in [[Yan Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=11]], he made Xu Xi and Mao Hui generals. When [[Yan Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=11]] fell into turmoil, both Xu Xi and Mao Hui turned traitor. After [[Yan Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=11]] was later pacified, they fled to seek refuge with Zang Ba. Cao Cao told Liu Bei to have Zang Ba send back the two men's heads. Zang Ba said to Liu Bei, "The reason I have attained my present standing is that I would never do such a thing. I have received from His Excellency the grace of being spared and preserved, and dare not defy his command. Yet a ruler destined for greatness can be reasoned with through righteousness. I hope you, General, will speak on my behalf." Liu Bei relayed Zang Ba's words to Cao Cao, who sighed and said to Zang Ba, "This is a deed of the ancients, and that you had the courage to uphold it is precisely what I had hoped to see." He then made both Xu Xi and Mao Hui [[Grand Administrators|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]].

orig.zht: 時太祖方與袁紹相拒，而霸數以精兵入[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]，故太祖得專事紹，不以東方為念。太祖破袁譚於[[南皮|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]，霸等會賀。霸因求遣子弟及諸將父兄家屬詣[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，太祖曰：「諸君忠孝，豈復在是！昔蕭何遣子弟入侍，而高祖不拒，耿純焚室輿櫬以從，而光武不逆，吾將何以易之哉！」東州擾攘，霸等執義征暴，清定海岱，功莫大焉，皆封[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。霸為[[都亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，加[[威虜將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-154]]。
orig.zhs: 时太祖方与袁绍相拒，而霸数以精兵入[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]，故太祖得专事绍，不以东方为念。太祖破袁谭于[[南皮|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]，霸等会贺。霸因求遣子弟及诸将父兄家属诣[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，太祖曰：「诸君忠孝，岂复在是！昔萧何遣子弟入侍，而高祖不拒，耿纯焚室舆榇以从，而光武不逆，吾将何以易之哉！」东州扰攘，霸等执义征暴，清定海岱，功莫大焉，皆封[[列侯|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。霸为[[都亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，加[[威虏将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-154]]。

passages.en: At the time, Cao Cao was locked in confrontation with Yuan Shao. As Zang Ba repeatedly launched attacks into [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] with elite troops, Cao Cao was free to devote his full attention to Yuan Shao without concern for the eastern front. When Cao Cao defeated Yuan Tan at [[Nanpi|/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]], Zang Ba and the others gathered to congratulate. Zang Ba then asked to send his younger clansmen and the families of his generals to [[Ye|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]. Cao Cao said, "Your loyalty and filial devotion surely do not depend on this! In the past, Xiao He sent his younger kinsmen to serve at court, and Emperor Gaozu did not refuse them. Geng Chun burned down his home and brought along his own coffin to follow Emperor Guangwu, and Emperor Guangwu did not turn him away. How could I do otherwise!" As the eastern provinces were in turmoil, Zang Ba and the others upheld righteousness and pacified the region between Mount Tai and the Bohai Sea. None surpassed their achievements, and all were enfeoffed as [[Marquises|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]. Zang Ba became a [[Capital Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]], and [[General Who Awes the Enemies|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-154]].

orig.zht: 又與于禁討昌豨，與夏侯淵討黃巾餘賊徐和等，有功，遷[[徐州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]。[[沛國|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=26]]武周為[[下邳|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.12209323&lng=117.9033062&name=Xiapi]]令，霸敬異周，身詣令舍。[[部從事|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-021]]謥詷不法，周得其罪，便收考竟，霸益以善周。從討孫權，先登，再入[[巢湖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=276]]，攻[[居巢|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]]，破之。
orig.zhs: 又与于禁讨昌豨，与夏侯渊讨黄巾余贼徐和等，有功，迁[[徐州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=8]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]。[[沛国|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=26]]武周为[[下邳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.12209323&lng=117.9033062&name=Xiapi]]令，霸敬异周，身诣令舍。[[部从事|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-021]]谥詷不法，周得其罪，便收考竟，霸益以善周。从讨孙权，先登，再入[[巢湖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=276]]，攻[[居巢|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]]，破之。

passages.en: Zang Ba also joined Yu Jin in campaigning against Chang Xi, and Xiahou Yuan in campaigning against Xu He and other Yellow Turban remnants. For his achievements he was promoted to [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Xu Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]. At the time, Wu Zhou of [[Pei State|/maps/map-overall?admin=26]] served as Prefect of [[Xiapi|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.12209323&lng=117.9033062&name=Xiapi]]. Zang Ba respected and admired Wu Zhou, and personally visited his residence. When a [[Regional Affairs Aide|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-021]] acted unlawfully and abused his authority, Wu Zhou uncovered his crimes, arrested him, and brought him to justice. Zang Ba held Zhou in even higher regard as a result. Zang Ba then joined the campaign against Sun Quan, taking the lead in the assault. He later advanced into [[Chao Lake|/maps/map-overall?water=276]], attacked [[Juchao|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]], and captured it.

orig.zht: 張遼之討陳蘭，霸別遣至[[皖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=30.62607288&lng=116.60310353&name=Wan]]，討吳將韓當，使權不得救蘭。當遣兵逆霸，霸與戰於逢龍，當復遣兵邀霸於[[夾石|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.24804329&lng=116.99614735&name=Jiashi]]，與戰破之，還屯[[舒|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]。權遣數萬人乘舩屯[[舒口|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.53432438&lng=117.36806282&name=Shukou]]，分兵救蘭，聞霸軍在[[舒|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]，遁還。霸夜追之，比明，行百餘里，邀賊前後擊之。賊窘急，不得上舩，赴水者甚衆。由是賊不得救蘭，遼遂破之。
orig.zhs: 张辽之讨陈兰，霸别遣至[[皖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=30.62607288&lng=116.60310353&name=Wan]]，讨吴将韩当，使权不得救兰。当遣兵逆霸，霸与战于逢龙，当复遣兵邀霸于[[夹石|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.24804329&lng=116.99614735&name=Jiashi]]，与战破之，还屯[[舒|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]。权遣数万人乘船屯[[舒口|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.53432438&lng=117.36806282&name=Shukou]]，分兵救兰，闻霸军在[[舒|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]，遁还。霸夜追之，比明，行百余里，邀贼前后击之。贼窘急，不得上船，赴水者甚众。由是贼不得救兰，辽遂破之。

passages.en: When Zhang Liao campaigned against Chen Lan, Zang Ba was separately dispatched to [[Wan|/maps/map-overall?lat=30.62607288&lng=116.60310353&name=Wan]], to attack the Wu general Han Dang, so as to prevent Sun Quan from relieving Chen Lan. Han Dang sent troops to meet Zang Ba, and they fought at Fenglong. Han Dang again sent troops to intercept Zang Ba at [[Jiashi|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.24804329&lng=116.99614735&name=Jiashi]]. Zang Ba fought and defeated them there, then withdrew to garrison at [[Shu|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]. Sun Quan dispatched several tens of thousands of troops by boat to garrison at [[Shukou|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.53432438&lng=117.36806282&name=Shukou]], detaching a force to relieve Chen Lan. Upon hearing that Zang Ba's army was at [[Shu|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]], they retreated immediately. Zang Ba pursued through the night, and by dawn had marched over a hundred li, intercepting the enemy and striking them front and back. Pressed by the attacks, the enemy could not reach their boats, and many threw themselves into the water. Because of this the enemy could not relieve Chen Lan, and Zhang Liao went on to defeat him.

orig.zht: 霸從討孫權於[[濡須口|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]]，與張遼為前鋒，行遇霖雨，大軍先及，水遂長，賊舩稍進，將士皆不安。遼欲去，霸止之曰：「公明於利鈍，寧肯捐吾等邪？」明日果有令。遼至，以語太祖。太祖善之，拜[[揚威將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]，[[假節|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]。後權乞降，太祖還，留霸與夏侯惇等屯[[居巢|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]]。
orig.zhs: 霸从讨孙权于[[濡须口|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]]，与张辽为前锋，行遇霖雨，大军先及，水遂长，贼船稍进，将士皆不安。辽欲去，霸止之曰：「公明于利钝，宁肯捐吾等邪？」明日果有令。辽至，以语太祖。太祖善之，拜[[扬威将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]，[[假节|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]。后权乞降，太祖还，留霸与夏侯惇等屯[[居巢|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]]。

passages.en: Zang Ba later joined the campaign against Sun Quan at [[Ruxukou|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]], serving as vanguard together with Zhang Liao. On the march, the army encountered continuous rain. After the main force arrived, the waters rose, and the enemy's boats gradually advanced, causing unease among the men. Zhang Liao wished to withdraw, but Zang Ba stopped him, saying, "His Excellency understands perfectly what is at stake. Why would he abandon us?" The next day, orders to retreat did indeed arrive. Zhang Liao then told Cao Cao of the conversation. Cao Cao praised Zang Ba, and appointed him [[General Who Promotes Might|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]], and [[Provisional Bearer of the Imperial Tally|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]. Afterwards, when Sun Quan sought to surrender, Cao Cao withdrew, leaving Zang Ba together with Xiahou Dun and others to garrison at [[Juchao|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]].

orig.zht: 文帝即王位，遷[[鎮東將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-068]]，進爵武安[[鄉侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]]，[[都督|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]諸軍事。及踐阼，進封[[開陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]][[侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]]，徙封[[良成|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.28604285&lng=118.02894911&name=Liangcheng]][[侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]]。與曹休討吳賊，破呂範於[[洞浦|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.64351707&lng=118.35843748&name=Dongpu]]，徵為[[執金吾|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#others-282]]，位[[特進|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-118]]。每有軍事，帝常咨訪焉。
orig.zhs: 文帝即王位，迁[[镇东将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-068]]，进爵武安[[乡侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]]，[[都督|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]诸军事。及践阼，进封[[开阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]][[侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]]，徙封[[良成|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.28604285&lng=118.02894911&name=Liangcheng]][[侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]]。与曹休讨吴贼，破吕范于[[洞浦|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.64351707&lng=118.35843748&name=Dongpu]]，征为[[执金吾|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#others-282]]，位[[特进|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-118]]。每有军事，帝常咨访焉。

passages.en: When Cao Pi (posthumously honoured as Emperor Wen, the Civil Emperor) succeeded as King of Wei, Zang Ba was promoted to [[General Who Garrisons the East|/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-068]], advanced in rank to Wu'an [[Township Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]], the Township Marquis of Martial Pacification, and appointed as [[Commander|/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]] of all military affairs in [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]. When Cao Pi ascended the imperial throne, Zang Ba was further enfeoffed as [[Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]] of [[Kaiyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]], then reassigned as [[Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]] of [[Liangcheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.28604285&lng=118.02894911&name=Liangcheng]]. He joined Cao Xiu in campaigning against the Wu, defeating Lü Fan at [[Dongpu|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.64351707&lng=118.35843748&name=Dongpu]], and was summoned to the capital to become [[Bearer of the Golden Mace|/translations/officials/ministers#others-282]], ranked [[Specially Advanced|/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-118]]. Whenever military affairs arose, the Emperor regularly sought his counsel.

source.en: Weilüe / Brief History of Wei (Yu Huan)

annotations.zht: 魏略曰：霸一名奴寇。孫觀名嬰子。吳敦名黯奴。尹禮名盧兒。建安二十四年，霸遣別軍在[[洛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]。會太祖崩，霸所部及[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]兵，以為天下將亂，皆鳴鼓擅去。文帝即位，以曹休[[都督|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]，霸謂休曰：「國家未肯聽霸耳！若假霸步騎萬人，必能橫行江表。」休言之於帝，帝疑霸軍前擅去，今意壯乃爾。遂東巡，因霸來朝而奪其兵。
annotations.zhs: 魏略曰：霸一名奴寇。孙观名婴子。吴敦名黯奴。尹礼名卢儿。建安二十四年，霸遣别军在[[洛|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]。会太祖崩，霸所部及[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]兵，以为天下将乱，皆鸣鼓擅去。文帝即位，以曹休[[都督|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]，霸谓休曰：「国家未肯听霸耳！若假霸步骑万人，必能横行江表。」休言之于帝，帝疑霸军前擅去，今意壮乃尔。遂东巡，因霸来朝而夺其兵。
annotations.en: The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: Zang Ba's other name was Nukou. Sun Guan's other name was Yingzi. Wu Dun's other name was Annu. Yin Li's other name was Lu'er. In the 24th year of Jian'an, Zang Ba sent a detached force stationed at [[Luoyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]. When Cao Cao died, Zang Ba's own troops together with the [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] soldiery, believing the realm was about to fall into chaos, all beat their drums and departed without orders. When Cao Pi ascended the throne, he had Cao Xiu serve as [[Commander|/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]] over [[Qing|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] and [[Xu|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]] provinces. Zang Ba said to Cao Xiu, "The court has simply not been willing to entrust me! If I were given ten thousand infantry and cavalry, I could certainly sweep across the Yangtze frontier." Cao Xiu reported this to the Emperor. The Emperor had long been suspicious of Zang Ba for previously withdrawing his army without orders. Now, seeing that he remained as bold as ever, the emperor made an eastern tour and, when Zang Ba came to court, stripped him of his command.

orig.zht: 明帝即位，增邑五百，并前三千五百戶。薨，謚曰威侯。子艾嗣。艾官至[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]、[[少府|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]]。艾薨，謚曰恭侯。子權嗣。霸前後有功，封子三人[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]，賜一人爵[[關內侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]。
orig.zhs: 明帝即位，增邑五百，并前三千五百户。薨，谥曰威侯。子艾嗣。艾官至[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]、[[少府|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]]。艾薨，谥曰恭侯。子权嗣。霸前后有功，封子三人[[列侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]，赐一人爵[[关内侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]。

passages.en: When Cao Rui (posthumously honoured as Emperor Ming, the Illustrious Emperor) ascended the throne, Zang Ba's fief was increased by five hundred households, bringing his total to three thousand five hundred. When Zang Ba died, he was posthumously honoured as Marquis Wei, the Formidable Marquis. His son Zang Ai succeeded him. Zang Ai eventually rose in office to [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] and [[Minister of the Lesser Treasury|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]]. When Zang Ai died, he was posthumously honoured as Marquis Gong, the Deferential Marquis. Zang Ai's son Zang Quan succeeded him. Across his career Zang Ba had rendered such service that three of his sons were enfeoffed as [[Marquises|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]], and one was granted the rank of [[Marquis Within the Passes|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]].

annotations.zht: 魏書曰：艾少以才理稱，為[[黃門郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]]，歷位[[郡守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。霸一子舜，字太伯，晉[[散騎常侍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-013]]，見武帝百官名。此百官名，不知誰所撰也，皆有題目，稱舜「才頴條暢，識贊時宜」也。
annotations.zhs: 魏书曰：艾少以才理称，为[[黄门郎|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]]，历位[[郡守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。霸一子舜，字太伯，晋[[散骑常侍|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-013]]，见武帝百官名。此百官名，不知谁所撰也，皆有题目，称舜「才颖条畅，识赞时宜」也。
annotations.en: The Book of Wei states: Zang Ai, while young, was praised for his talent and judgement. He became [[Gentleman within the Yellow Gates|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]], and served successively as [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of various commanderies. Zang Ba had another son, Zang Shun, courtesy name Taibo, who under the Jin became [[Cavalier Regular Attendant|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-013]]. This is mentioned in the book Wudi Baiguanming, The Register of Officials under Emperor Wu. The author of this book is unknown. Each entry in the book carries a heading, and Zang Shun's states that he was "Exceptionally talented, clear-minded, and discerning in the affairs of the age."

orig.zht: 而孫觀亦至[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，[[假節|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]，從太祖討孫權，戰被創，薨。子毓嗣，亦至[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]。
orig.zhs: 而孙观亦至[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，[[假节|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]，从太祖讨孙权，战被创，薨。子毓嗣，亦至[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]。

passages.en: Sun Guan likewise rose to become [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]], and [[Provisional Bearer of the Imperial Tally|/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]. He followed Cao Cao in campaigning against Sun Quan, was wounded in battle, and died. His son Sun Yu succeeded him, and likewise rose to become [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]].

annotations.zht: 魏書曰：孫觀字仲臺，[[泰山|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=33]]人。與臧霸俱起，討黃巾，拜[[騎都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。太祖破呂布，使霸招觀兄弟，皆厚遇之。與霸俱戰伐，觀常為先登，征定[[青|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]羣賊，功次於霸，封呂都[[亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。康亦以功封列侯。與太祖會[[南皮|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]，遣子弟入居[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，拜觀[[偏將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-164]]，遷[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]。從征孫權於[[濡須口|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]]，假節。攻權，為流矢所中，傷左足，力戰不顧，太祖勞之曰：「將軍被創深重，而猛氣益奮，不當為國愛身乎？」轉[[振威將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]，創甚，遂卒。
annotations.zhs: 魏书曰：孙观字仲台，[[泰山|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=33]]人。与臧霸俱起，讨黄巾，拜[[骑都尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。太祖破吕布，使霸招观兄弟，皆厚遇之。与霸俱战伐，观常为先登，征定[[青|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]羣贼，功次于霸，封吕都[[亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。康亦以功封列侯。与太祖会[[南皮|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]，遣子弟入居[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，拜观[[偏将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-164]]，迁[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]。从征孙权于[[濡须口|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]]，假节。攻权，为流矢所中，伤左足，力战不顾，太祖劳之曰：「将军被创深重，而猛气益奋，不当为国爱身乎？」转[[振威将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]，创甚，遂卒。
annotations.en: The Book of Wei states: Sun Guan, courtesy name Zhongtai, was from [[Taishan|/maps/map-overall?admin=33]]. He rose up together with Zang Ba, campaigning against the Yellow Turbans, and was appointed [[Commandant of Cavalry|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]. When Cao Cao defeated Lü Bu, he had Zang Ba summon Sun Guan and his brothers, and treated them all generously. Fighting alongside Zang Ba in every campaign, Sun Guan was always at the forefront of the assaults. In pacifying the various rebel bands of [[Qing|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] and [[Xu|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]] provinces, his achievements ranked just below Zang Ba's, and he was enfeoffed as Lüdu [[Neighborhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]. Sun Kang was likewise enfeoffed as a Marquis for his achievements. When he met with Cao Cao at [[Nanpi|/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]], Sun Guan sent his younger kin to reside at [[Ye|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]], and was appointed [[Adjunct General|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-164]], later promoted to [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]. He followed the campaign against Sun Quan at [[Ruxukou|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]], and was made Provisional Bearer of the Imperial Tally. During the campaign against Sun Quan, he was struck by a stray arrow that severely wounded his left foot. Yet he fought on relentlessly. Cao Cao commended him, saying, "General, your wound is grievous, yet your fighting spirit only grows fiercer. Should you not also cherish yourself for the sake of the state?" He was relocated to [[General Who Rallies Might|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]. Later his wound worsened, and he died.
